entrada.titulo: An investigation on real-time insights: enhancing process control with IoT-enabled sensor networks

perfil_anterior.problema: IoT devices introduce novel vulnerabilities for cybercriminals, heightening dangers to data security and privacy.
perfil_anterior.solucao: strategies like energy harvesting, low-power communication protocols and sleep scheduling are being investigated
perfil_anterior.avaliacao: These technologies facilitate interconnected systems and optimize operations by enhancing efficiency, predictive maintenance, and sustainability.
